narrative: OMX30 enters Wednesday with tailwinds from a robust US equity close, particularly NASDAQ's +2.26% surge, offsetting modest continental weakness (DAX -0.47%, FTSE -0.23%). The index maintains a strong structural bull setup: +6.8% above the 200-MA, MACD above signal line, and ROC-90 at +8.4% confirming 90-day momentum. USD/SEK's +0.33% lift is a key catalyst for heavy industrials (28% of index), while Copper's +0.93% gain directly benefits Boliden. However, RSI at 60.32 leaves room before overbought conditions, and the index sits at 98% of 52-week range—elevation into potential mean reversion territory. Watch for US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET as a volatility trigger.
morningBrief: OMX30 should open +0.4% to +0.7% on overnight US strength and risk-on reversal. The bull structure is intact (6.8% above 200-MA, MACD bullish, ADX 20.3), but elevated positioning (98% of 52W range, -0.5% from high) demands tactical discipline. Key levels: support 3085 (lower Bollinger), resistance 3180 (50-MA). Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo, Sandvik) and Materials (Boliden) lead on USD strength and copper firmness; Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken) steady as yields stabilize. Tech/Telecom (Ericsson, Hexagon) benefit from NASDAQ momentum offset by valuation sensitivity to easing yields. Avoid FOMO above 3150—watch US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) for direction confirmation. Risk: trade war headlines (Trump/China) could trigger a VIX reversal.
